messages:
fix: coupon on post-volume subtotal; inclusive coupon expiry

Finance reported a coupon stacked with a volume discount took off more
than the README specifies: the percentage coupon was computed on the
order's gross total instead of on the subtotal after volume discounts.
A customer also had a coupon refused as expired on its documented last
valid day, because the expiry check excluded that day.

Fixes src/pricing.ts to base the coupon on (gross - volume discount),
and src/coupons.ts to accept dates up to and including validUntil, per
the README's discount and coupon rules. Adds regression tests for both.
